ValidationRule.description: If Verification Result is Refer to Service Center then Service Center Result must be Refer to Return to Verifier
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Verification_Result__c, "Refer to Service Center"),ISCHANGED(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c, "Return to Verifier")), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c))), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Case Should be return to Verifier as it was assigned by Verification Team.
